claim: The monastic reform era associated with Parakramabahu I was also a major period of Pali intellectual production: specialist research links the post-1157 reform milieu to new grammatical literature and the Moggallana grammatical school, making textual reorganization part of the institutional rebuilding of the sangha rather than a separate cultural ornament.
bounded_by: This is a scholarly interpretation of the relationship between reform and literary production. It does not mean every grammatical work was commissioned directly by the king or that political stability mechanically caused scholarship.
notes: Promotes the defensible core of GF-LIT-03 and supports a bridge to GF-SAS-09.
